name: Love in Oasis
source:
A visual novel set during a zombie apocalypse.

You'll play as a Nameable MC. Together with 10 year old Kira you venture towards a secure settlement that you've heard of down south. But you should’ve known it wouldn’t be a walk in the park to get there… Will you find romance or heartbreak wherever you end up?

[From [url=https://iamthoe.itch.io/love-in-oasis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以僵尸末日为背景的视觉小说。

你将扮演一名可命名的MC。你和10岁的基拉一起冒险前往南方一个你听说过的安全定居点。但你应该知道，到达那里并不是在公园里散步那么简单……无论你走到哪里，你会发现浪漫还是心碎吗？

[来自[url=https://iamthoe.itch.io/love-in-oasis]Itch.io[/url]]
